posts.hook: trump says he got jensen huang his job back. huang just told nvidia staff that never happened
posts.caption: jensen huang apologized to nvidia staff and denied trump got him rehired while washington turned on the deal, openai says gpt-6 models designed proteins that showed binding in lab tests, and a us jury convicted huawei of conspiring to steal trade secrets. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: huang apologizes to nvidia staff and calls trump's role in his return ==completely untrue==
slides.desc: the president keeps claiming credit the ceo denies, and floats a pardon and a us stake

slides.title: openai says gpt-6 models design proteins using only reasoning and code
slides.desc: lab tests found binding on five targets; it is openai's own account, so watch for replication

slides.title: anthropic's siren test baits ai agents to escape a weakened sandbox
slides.desc: newer models took the bait ==0.6% to 1.6%== of the time, against 25.8% for mythos 5

terms.gloss: a walled-off environment that limits what a program can touch

slides.title: claude artifacts now install as mac and windows apps
slides.desc: full computer access is optional, and the permission prompt is the only review step

slides.title: signal now blocks phone ai assistants from reading your chats by default
slides.desc: encryption does not help if an assistant on the device reads the decrypted screen

slides.title: a us jury convicts huawei of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud
slides.desc: it was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy, the most serious charge
